LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Hydra.nodes.0.label: Many-headed Embrace
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Hydra.nodes.0.description: Retains this Hydra relic’s original Many Heads or Hunt awakening without granting its bonuses twice. Progress belongs to this item and only its current wearer can use it. Every 3 effective ordinary hits slash up to 2 other enemies within 3.5 cells of the main target for 50 damage each. Four-second cooldown; hits during it do not count. A full charge waits if no secondary target is present. Extra damage does not build charge. Base rewards: damage 50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Hydra.nodes.1.label: Tooth Marks
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Hydra.nodes.1.description: Secondary enemies actually damaged by Many-headed Embrace’s sweep receive a 4-second tooth mark, up to 2 at once. Your next ordinary hit on one spends its mark for 75 slashing damage, with a one-second cooldown per target. A hit cannot spend a mark it just created. Base rewards: damage 75.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Hydra.nodes.2.label: Returning Bite
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Hydra.nodes.2.description: Remember the latest Many-headed Embrace’s sweep’s main and tooth-marked secondary targets. Land an ordinary hit on a marked secondary enemy, then hit the original within 4 seconds for 50 extra damage. Once per sweep; a new sweep replaces the record, and either selected victim dying ends it. Base rewards: damage 50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Hydra.nodes.3.label: Following Bite
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Hydra.nodes.3.description: After Tooth Marks deals actual bonus damage, slash the nearest other enemy within 3 cells of that victim for 50 damage. Two-second cooldown. This does not trigger Many-headed Embrace’s sweep or Tooth Marks again. Base rewards: damage 50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Hydra.nodes.4.label: Earned Meal
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Hydra.nodes.4.description: Enemies actually damaged by Tooth Marks’ bonus strike receive a 4-second feeding mark, up to 2 at once. A later ordinary hit spends that mark to heal up to 2 of your non-permanent injury. Four-second cooldown. Full health keeps the mark; a hit cannot spend a mark it just created. Base rewards: healing 40.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Hydra.nodes.5.label: Closing Jaws
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Hydra.nodes.5.description: Completing Returning Bite links its selected victims for 3 seconds. While both live, a later ordinary hit on either adds 50 damage to the other if it is within 3 cells of its recorded position. Each link works once; being out of range neither spends nor extends it. Base rewards: damage 50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Hydra.nodes.6.label: Guarding Jaws
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Relic_Hydra.nodes.6.description: When Returning Bite deals actual bonus damage, gain a separate 50-point shield for 3 seconds. Four-second cooldown. Ordinary damage alone, fully absorbed bonus damage and another wearer’s return strike do not grant this shield. Base rewards: shield 50.
